# iStock
> iStock is a royalty-free stock media marketplace for photos, illustrations, vectors, videos, and audio.

iStock helps designers, marketers, publishers, and businesses find licensable creative assets for commercial and editorial-style projects. The site includes searchable media libraries, pricing and subscription information, contributor resources, and legal guidance on licensing and usage.

## Core Library
- [Stock Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos): Browse royalty-free stock photography across business, lifestyle, nature, and more.
- [Illustrations](https://www.istockphoto.com/illustrations): Explore royalty-free illustrations for editorial, marketing, and design use.
- [Vectors](https://www.istockphoto.com/vectors): Find scalable vector graphics, icons, patterns, and design elements.
- [Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos): Search royalty-free stock video clips in HD and 4K.
- [Music](https://www.istockphoto.com/music): Discover royalty-free music tracks for video, ads, and digital content.
- [Search](https://www.istockphoto.com/search/2/image): Access the main search experience for images and media assets.

## Popular Browse Pages
- [Nature Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/nature): Browse stock photos featuring landscapes, wildlife, and outdoor scenes.
- [Business Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/business): Find business-themed imagery for presentations, websites, and campaigns.
- [People Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/people): Explore portraits and lifestyle imagery featuring diverse people and situations.
- [Backgrounds Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/background): Search abstract, textured, and studio background images.
- [Technology Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/technology): Browse technology and innovation imagery for modern digital topics.
- [Food Photos](https://www.istockphoto.com/photos/food): Find food photography for menus, packaging, blogs, and advertising.

## Video Collections
- [Stock Video Footage](https://www.istockphoto.com/footage): Browse curated royalty-free footage collections across subjects and styles.
- [Nature Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos/nature): Explore nature footage including landscapes, wildlife, and environmental scenes.
- [Business Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos/business): Find business and workplace stock footage for corporate storytelling.
- [Background Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos/background): Search motion backgrounds and abstract looping footage.
- [Aerial Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos/aerial): Browse aerial and drone footage for travel, real estate, and landscapes.
- [People Videos](https://www.istockphoto.com/videos/people): Discover lifestyle and portrait footage featuring people in everyday settings.

## Pricing and Plans
- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.istockphoto.com/plans-and-pricing): Compare subscriptions and credit packs for images, video, and audio.
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.istockphoto.com/plans-and-pricing/subscriptions): Review recurring download plans for frequent asset use.
- [Credit Packs](https://www.istockphoto.com/plans-and-pricing/credits): See prepaid credit options for flexible on-demand purchases.
- [Premium + Video](https://www.istockphoto.com/plans-and-pricing/premium-video): Compare plans that include premium imagery and video downloads.
- [Basic Subscriptions](https://www.istockphoto.com/plans-and-pricing/basic-subscriptions): View entry-level image subscription options for common creative needs.

## Licensing and Legal
- [License Comparison](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/images-license): Understand standard licensing terms and permitted asset usage.
- [Royalty-Free License FAQ](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/license-faq): Read common questions about royalty-free licensing and restrictions.
- [Legal Overview](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/legal): Access legal resources related to usage, rights, and compliance.
- [Model and Property Releases](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/model-release): Learn how releases affect commercial use of stock assets.
- [Content Usage Guide](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/how-to-use-stock-photos): Review practical guidance for using stock imagery correctly.

## Creative Resources
- [Resources Hub](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources): Explore educational content about stock media, design, and licensing.
- [Stock Photo Tips](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/stock-photo-tips): Learn how to choose effective stock imagery for projects.
- [Visual Trends](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/trends): Discover trend-focused insights for current creative and marketing work.
- [Small Business Resources](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/small-business): Find content tailored to small business marketing and branding.
- [Video Resources](https://www.istockphoto.com/resources/video): Access articles and guidance focused on stock footage usage.

## Contributor Information
- [Become a Contributor](https://www.istockphoto.com/sell-stock): Learn how photographers and artists can submit content to iStock.
- [Contributor by Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/workwithus): Access contributor onboarding and submission information from Getty Images.
- [Contributor Community](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/): Sign in to contributor tools, submissions, and account management.
- [Submission Requirements](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/article_public.aspx?article_id=3047): Review technical and quality requirements for submitted content.
- [Contributor Help](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/article_public.aspx?article_id=3490): Find support articles for contributor workflows and policies.

## Help and Account
- [Help Center](https://www.istockphoto.com/help): Get support for downloads, billing, licensing, and account issues.
- [Contact Us](https://www.istockphoto.com/contact-us): Reach iStock support for account and purchasing assistance.
- [Sign In](https://www.istockphoto.com/sign-in): Access your iStock account, downloads, and saved boards.
- [Join](https://www.istockphoto.com/join): Create an iStock account to save, purchase, and organize assets.
- [Boards](https://www.istockphoto.com/collaboration/boards): Organize and collaborate on saved creative asset collections.

## Company and Policies
- [About iStock](https://www.istockphoto.com/about): Learn about iStock and its role within Getty Images.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.istockphoto.com/legal/terms-of-use): Review the site’s terms governing access and usage.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.istockphoto.com/legal/privacy-policy): Read how iStock collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.istockphoto.com/legal/cookie-policy): Understand cookie usage and related preference controls.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.istockphoto.com/legal/accessibility): Review accessibility commitments and support information.
